_description: Figure 3 synthetic knees: the healthy-to-mild-OA shape axis, knees placed along it, each built like a cohort knee and walked through the nine measured gaits. Model building uses config/reconstruction.json and the simulations use config/measured_gait/<donor>.json; this file adds only the axis definition, where the run goes, and the three build keys a synthetic knee may set.

run._note: The run writes the synthetic tree, <root>/synthetic_shape_axis = 02_simulations/synthetic_shape_axis, which derive_figure3_data.py reads. The v2 synthetic tree was built by this config with model_version fig5_cohort_build and RSubject_121 as the ninth donor.

axis._note: Axis = unit(mean(to_group) - mean(from_group)) in raw 2069-value descriptor units; sigma steps are the population mean + k * sd * axis, anchors sit at each group's mean projection.
axis._descriptor_models_note: The cohort's saved shape-model fits, the same tree reconstruction.json's inputs.saved_fits reads. A rebuild never refits, so these latents and alignments are the cohort's whichever run is building; reading them here rather than from the run's own 01_models lets the axis be derived before any knee is rebuilt.

build._note: Everything about model building comes from reconstruction_config. meniscus_center_mode is midline, the same trim centre as the cohort's models; as_run reproduces the trim centres of the v2 synthetic knees. model_version is the run the data root declares, as for the cohort.

simulate._note: One measured-gait config per donor; the reference (overground) gait is not simulated for the synthetic knees.
